abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's melee weapons, including Companion weapons, while the target is in combat, damaged or destroyed.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Magmadroth's Claws and Horns is 4.

abilities.name: Seeing Red
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect:
Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, pick 1 of the following effects:
*Channelled Ire*: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Companion melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
*Cathartic Release*: Roll a number of dice equal to your fury level. For each 4+, Heal (1) this unit.
*Shield of Anger*: This unit has Ward (5+) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Volcanic Blood
abilities.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the Fight ability has been resolved.

warscrolls.name: Scourge of Aqshy Vulkyn Flameseekers
notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2026-27 battlepack.

abilities.name: Fiery Disposition
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn, where X is equal to your fury level.
*Vigour of the Ur-Salamander*: Add X" to this unit's Move characteristic.
*Fiery Determination*: Add X to this unit's control score.
*Kyndlewrath*: Add X to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Emberteeth.

abilities.name: MULTIPLE PARTS
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this MANIFESTATION’s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this MANIFESTATION is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: ENSNARING SOUL-DRAIN
abilities.effect: Each time an enemy unit uses a MOVE ability while it is within 9" of any parts of this MANIFESTATION, the effects of the ‘FLY’ ability do not apply to that unit. Enemy units cannot be set up within 9" of either part of this MANIFESTATION.

abilities.name: PHANTASMAL TRANSLOCATION
abilities.effect: Pick a part of this MANIFESTATION, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 9" of the other part and more than 3" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: DEATHLY PASSAGE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 6" of one part of this MANIFESTATION to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the other part of this MANIFESTATION and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: MULTIPLE PARTS
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this MANIFESTATION’s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this MANIFESTATION is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: BOUND FOR THE GREAT OUBLIETTE
abilities.declare: For each part of this MANIFESTATION, you can pick an enemy unit within 3" of that part to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:
Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
Subtract a number of inches equal to the roll from the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: MULTIPLE PARTS
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this MANIFESTATION’s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this MANIFESTATION is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Stonebreaker Apprentice Runestriker
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's shooting attacks to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects:
Rune of Detonation: Roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 3" of the target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
Rune of Thunder: Until the start of your next turn, the target has a maximum control score of 1.
Rune of Earthshaking: The target cannot use Run abilities until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Artillerist's Revenge
abilities.effect: This unit's ranged weapons have Crit (2 Hits) while it has any grudge marks.

abilities.name: PULLED TO THE GRAVE
abilities.effect: This MANIFESTATION can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, you can pick an enemy unit that this MANIFESTATION passed across during that move to be the target. Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: BURNING UP
abilities.effect: Each time this MANIFESTATION uses a SHOOT ability, after that ability has been resolved, allocate 1 damage point to this MANIFESTATION (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point).

warscrolls.name: Thrynn
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Kromdron Noble.

abilities.name: Fight Shoulder to Shoulder
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit or a non-Hero Kromdron Infantry unit within 3" of and visible to this unit
abilities.effect:
If you declared a Fight ability for this unit, pick a friendly non-Hero Kromdron Infantry unit that has not used a Fight ability this turn, is within this unit's combat range and is visible to this unit to be the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.
If you declared a Fight ability for a friendly non-Hero Kromdron Infantry unit, if this unit has not used a Fight ability this turn, it can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by the friendly non-Hero Kromdron Infantry unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's attacks for the rest of the turn.
Designer's Note: *This ability lets another friendly unit fight immediately after this unit or lets this unit fight immediately after that other friendly unit. Add 1 to hit rolls for whichever of those two units fights after the first.*

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a Fight ability for this unit or a non-Hero Kromdron Infantry unit within 3" of and visible to this unit

abilities.name: Steadfast Retribution
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons, to a maximum of +3, for each other visible friendly unit wholly within 6" of this unit that has any grudge marks.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Karak War Council's Armoury is 4.

abilities.name: Forge a Path
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Move ability for this unit in your movement phase
abilities.effect: Pick a visible friendly Kromdron Infantry unit that is wholly within 6" of this unit, is not in combat and has not been set up this turn to be the target. Remove the target from the battlefield. After this unit ends its move, you must set up the target wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a Move ability for this unit in your movement phase

abilities.name: Defend the Throne!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick another visible friendly Khazalite Holds unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be a target. For each grudge mark this unit has, you can pick another eligible unit to be an additional target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, the targets' melee weapons have Anti-charge (+1 Rend) while they are wholly within 6" of this unit. Add 3" to this range for each grudge mark this unit has.

abilities.name: Tectonic Impact
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Karak War Council
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:
Stonesmith's Passage: *The Stonesmith shifts rock and earth to aid the manoeuvres of nearby duardin.* Add 2" to the Move characteristic of visible friendly Khazalite Holds Infantry units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on those friendly units by Retreat abilities.
Grudgebearer's Accusation: *The grudgebearer singles out an enemy champion to be the target of the duardin's vengeance.* Pick a visible enemy Hero within 18" of this unit to be the target. Friendly Khazalite Holds Infantry units can ignore the effects of the 'Guarded Hero' ability on the target when picking targets for their shooting attacks.
Holdseeker's Protection: *Awakening the runes on their staff, the holdseeker imbues nearby duardin with an aura that repels the attacks of the foe.* Pick a visible friendly Khazalite Holds unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target that friendly unit have no effect.

abilities.name: ARCANE PASSAGE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD within 3" of this MANIFESTATION to be the target.
abilities.effect: The next time the target uses a non-SUMMON SPELL ability this phase, add 1 to the casting value of that spell. When picking targets for that spell, you can measure range and visibility from either part of this MANIFESTATION instead of from the caster, and your opponent can measure range and visibility to either part of this MANIFESTATION instead of to the caster for the purposes of the ‘Unbind’ ability.

abilities.name: MULTIPLE PARTS
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this MANIFESTATION’s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this MANIFESTATION is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Shield Maidens
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each enemy model in combat with this unit. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Protection of Valaya
abilities.effect: While this unit has any grudge marks, visible friendly Khazalite Holds Infantry and non-Gholem War Machine units have Ward (5+) while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

abilities.name: Warriors of the Hearth
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is not in combat and has not used a Run or Retreat ability this turn, make a charge roll of 2D6. While this unit has any grudge marks, you can re-roll that charge roll.
abilities.effect:
This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units, pass across enemy models and must end that move within ½" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so, it has charged.
Then, if this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit it passed across this turn. Inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

warscrolls.name: Vulkite Berzerkers with Bladed Slingshields
notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

abilities.name: Berserk Fury
abilities.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the Fight ability has been resolved.

warscrolls.name: Vulkite Berzerkers with Fyresteel Weapons
notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

abilities.name: Whirlwind of Destruction
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons if this unit charged this turn.

abilities.name: Drothmasters
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Monster in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 2 from the Damage characteristic of the target's Companion melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Blunt Their Horns and Fangs!
abilities.effect:
While this unit has any grudge marks:
• Subtract 2 from the Attacks characteristic of Companion melee weapons used by enemy Monsters while they are in combat with this unit.
• Enemy Monsters cannot use Rampage abilities while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: MAGMA BLAST
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this MANIFESTATION’s shooting attacks if the target unit has 10 or more models. Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls instead if the target unit has 15 or more models.

abilities.name: Aureate Hide
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
abilities.effect: After that Fight ability has been resolved, if any enemy models were slain by that Fight ability, you can pick a visible friendly Fyreslayers Priest wholly within 12" of this unit. Give that Priest D3 ritual points.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a Fight ability for this unit

abilities.name: Intense Fyrestream
abilities.effect:
Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, for the rest of the turn:
• Add X" to the Range characteristic and X to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Companion ranged weapons, where X is equal to your fury level.
• This unit's Companion ranged weapons have Shoot in Combat.

abilities.name: Thickened Scales
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: COLLAPSING PASS
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick each objective to be the targets. Then, pick 1 of the targets to be the focus.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. Add 1 to the roll for each unit (friendly and enemy) that is contesting it. If the target is the focus, you can add 3 to or subtract 3 from the roll. On a 8+, remove the target from the battlefield.

abilities.name: SEARCH THE RUIN
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that does not have an emberstone nugget and is contesting a Sun Seekers objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Give the target an emberstone nugget. If you are the underdog, the target can immediately move 6" but cannot end that move in combat. The target cannot use the ‘Back to Base Camp’ or ‘Power Through’ ability for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: BACK TO BASE CAMP
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has an emberstone nugget, was not set up this turn and is contesting a Golden Lions objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target’s emberstone nugget.

abilities.name: SUMMON AETHERVOID PENDULUM
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Aethervoid Pendulum on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an Aethervoid Pendulum wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON QUICKSILVER SWORDS
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Quicksilver Swords endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Quicksilver Swords endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON CHRONOMANTIC COGS
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Chronomantic Cogs endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Chronomantic Cogs endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Well-travelled Roamers
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Run or Charge ability for a Khazalite Holds unit
abilities.effect: If that unit is more than 6" from all other friendly units, you can re-roll the dice that determines how far it can move.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a Run or Charge ability for a Khazalite Holds unit

abilities.name: Rune of Guarding
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: You can only use this ability if you have not used any Ur-gold Rune abilities this battle round. For the rest of the battle round, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each friendly Fyrd of Fyrepeak unit in each phase.

abilities.name: Rune of Speed
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: You can only use this ability if you have not used any Ur-gold Rune abilities this battle round. For the rest of the battle round, you can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for friendly Fyrd of Fyrepeak units.

abilities.name: Grimmdron Grudges
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly Fyrd of Fyrepeak unit destroys an enemy unit, give that friendly unit 1 grudge mark.

abilities.name: Rune of Spellbreaking
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
You can only use this ability if you have not used any Ur-gold Rune abilities this battle round. For the rest of the battle round:
• Subtract 2 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for enemy units.
• Add 1 to chanting rolls for friendly Fyrd of Fyrepeak units.

abilities.name: Rune of Fortune
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: You can only use this ability if you have not used any Ur-gold Rune abilities this battle round. For the rest of the battle round, if the unmodified hit roll for a shooting attack that targets a friendly Fyrd of Fyrepeak unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

abilities.name: Rune of Striking
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: You can only use this ability if you have not used any Ur-gold Rune abilities this battle round. For the rest of the battle round, add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made by friendly Fyrd of Fyrepeak units.

abilities.name: Thorgrim's Beard! There Are Grudges to Be Settled!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect:
If your general was destroyed this turn, you can give up to 3 friendly Khazalite Holds units 1 grudge mark.
Otherwise, pick up to 3 of the following effects:
• If any friendly Khazalite Holds units were destroyed this turn, give 1 grudge mark to a friendly Khazalite Holds unit.
• If any friendly Kromdron units are contesting an objective that is being contested by any enemy units, give 1 grudge mark to a friendly Khazalite Holds unit.
• If any friendly Grimmdron units charged this turn, are in combat, have not been destroyed and did not destroy an enemy unit this turn, give 1 grudge mark to a friendly Khazalite Holds unit.
• If any damage points were allocated to your general this turn, give 1 grudge mark to a friendly Khazalite Holds unit that is not your general.

abilities.name: By Grungni, Stand Firm!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly Duardin Khazalite Holds units to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the battle round, while a target has not used a Charge ability this battle round, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used for attacks that target that unit.
You cannot use any other Ancestral Vow abilities for the rest of the battle round.

abilities.name: Gazul, Remember the Fallen!
abilities.effect:
While at least half the models in a Duardin Khazalite Holds unit have been slain, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons.
Designer's Note: *Models that have been slain and returned to the unit do not count as having been slain for the purposes of this ability.*

abilities.name: We Honour Valaya!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly Duardin Khazalite Holds units in combat to be blessed by Valaya. Then, for each unit blessed by Valaya this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be its target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3 for each unit blessed by Valaya this turn. If that unit is Valayan, use a value of 3 instead. Inflict an amount of mortal damage on its target equal to the roll. Then, you can pick 1 of the following:
• Heal (X) the unit blessed by Valaya, where X is equal to the value of the roll.
• Return a number of slain models to the unit blessed by Valaya with a combined Health characteristic of up to the value of the roll.
You cannot use any other Ancestral Vow abilities for the rest of the battle round.

abilities.name: Enlighten Us with Your Wisdom, Grombrindal!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the battle round:
• Add 1 to casting rolls and chanting rolls for friendly Khazalite Holds units.
• While they are wholly within 12" of a friendly Khazalite Holds Wizard or Priest, friendly Khazalite Holds units have Ward (4+) against damage points inflicted by Spell abilities, Prayer abilities and abilities used by Manifestations.
You cannot use any other Ancestral Vow abilities for the rest of the battle round.

abilities.name: Inghilde, Our Light in the Darkness
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 1 friendly non-Hero Khazalite Holds Infantry unit and up to 1 friendly Khazalite Holds Infantry Hero that are wholly within 6" of the same terrain feature and not in combat to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 6" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units. If there are 2 targets, you must set them up within 3" of each other.
You cannot use any other Ancestral Vow abilities for the rest of the battle round.

abilities.name: Let It Be Known!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Khazalite Holds Hero to use this ability, then pick a visible friendly non-Hero Khazalite Holds unit wholly within 12" of that Hero to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has 1 additional grudge mark.

abilities.name: Reclaim the Karaks
abilities.effect:
Immediately after your opponent gains control of an objective within your territory, you can give 1 grudge mark to a friendly Khazalite Holds unit.
Each time a friendly Khazalite Holds unit uses the 'Retreat' ability, after that ability has been resolved, you must remove 1 grudge mark from that unit (if it has one).

abilities.name: Stalwart Resolve
abilities.effect: While an enemy unit is in combat with a friendly Khazalite Holds unit, subtract 1 from the number of inches that enemy unit can move when it makes a pile in move, to a minimum of 1".

abilities.name: ROLLING ASH-CLOUDS
abilities.effect:
While the ash-clouds are low-lying:
Units, terrain features and MANIFESTATIONS cannot be set up in neutral territory.
Units, terrain features and MANIFESTATIONS cannot end a move within neutral territory unless they started that move wholly within neutral territory.
Models, terrain features and MANIFESTATIONS are not visible to other models more than 3" away unless a straight line can be drawn between any points on their bases that does not cross neutral territory.

abilities.name: Rune of Courage
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Khazalite Holds Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for friendly Khazalite Holds units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.

abilities.name: Rune of the Furnace
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Khazalite Holds Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each visible enemy unit within 12" of the caster.

abilities.name: Rune of Dismay
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Khazalite Holds Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by enemy units while they are within 6" of the caster.

abilities.name: REDEPLOY
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Each model in that unit can move up to D6". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.

abilities.name: AT THE DOUBLE
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a RUN ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that RUN ability.
Do not make a run roll as part of that RUN ability. Instead, add 6" to that unit’s Move characteristic to determine the distance each model in that unit can move as part of that RUN ability.

abilities.name: ALL-OUT ATTACK
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared an ATTACK ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that ATTACK ability.
Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made as part of that ATTACK ability. This also affects weapons that have the Companion weapon ability. For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from save rolls for the unit using this ability.

abilities.name: FORWARD TO VICTORY
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that CHARGE ability.
You can re-roll the charge roll.

abilities.name: COUNTER-CHARGE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can use a CHARGE ability as if it were your charge phase.

abilities.name: GUARDED HERO
abilities.effect:
If this HERO(not MONSTER or WAR MACHINES) is within the combat range of a friendly unit that is not a HERO:
Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this HERO.
If this HERO is INFANTRY, they cannot be picked as the target of shooting attacks made by models more than 12" from them.

abilities.name: CHAMPION
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by champions in this unit. If this unit is a BEAST, this ability affects this unit’s Companion weapons.

abilities.name: DEPLOY FACTION TERRAIN
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly faction terrain feature that has not been deployed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up the target faction terrain feature wholly within friendly territory, more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features. After you have done so, it has been deployed.

abilities.name: DEPLOY REGIMENT
abilities.declare: Pick a regiment from your army roster to be the target. No units in that regiment can have already been deployed.
abilities.effect: Keep using DEPLOY abilities without alternating until all units in that regiment have been deployed. You cannot set up units that are not in that regiment on the battlefield or in reserve as part of any of those Deploy abilities.

abilities.name: DEPLOY UNIT
abilities.declare: Pick a unit from your army roster that has not been deployed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up the target unit wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from enemy territory. After you have done so, it has been deployed.

abilities.name: ALL-OUT DEFENCE
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: A unit targeted by that ATTACK ability.
Add 1 to save rolls for that unit until that ATTACK ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: SHOOT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick one or more enemy units as the target(s) of that unit’s attacks (see 16.0).
abilities.effect: Resolve shooting attacks against the target unit(s).

abilities.name: CHARGE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat and has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn to use this ability. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: That unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so, the unit using this ability has charged.

abilities.name: FIGHT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat or that charged this turn to use this ability. That unit can make a pile-in move (see 15.3). Then, if that unit is in combat, you must pick one or more enemy units as the target(s) of that unit’s attacks (see 16.0).
abilities.effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s).

abilities.name: NORMAL MOVE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. That unit cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: RUN
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Make a run roll of D6. That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic added to the run roll. That unit cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: RETREAT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit. That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units but cannot end that move within an enemy unit’s combat range.

abilities.name: MAGICAL INTERVENTION
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD or PRIEST to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That friendly unit can use a SPELL, PRAYER or BANISH ability (as appropriate) as if it were your hero phase. If you do so, subtract 1 from casting rolls or chanting rolls made as part of that ability.

abilities.name: RALLY
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect:
Make 6 rally rolls of D6. For each 4+, you receive 1 rally point. Rally points can be spent in the following ways:
For each rally point spent, Heal (1) that unit.
You can spend a number of rally points equal to the Health characteristic of that unit to return a slain model to that unit.
You can spend the rally points in any combination of the above. Unspent rally points are then lost.

abilities.name: STANDARD BEARER

abilities.name: GRIZZLED BUCCANEERS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:

This unit can immediately use a SHOOT ability as if it were your shooting phase but all of its attacks must target the target enemy unit.

notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

abilities.name: MOUSTACHE-MOUNTED AETHERBLASTERS
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: COMMAND THE FLEET
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly SKYVESSELS wholly within 24" of this unit that are not in combat to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Each target can use a RUN ability and still use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities later in the turn.

abilities.name: FIRST RULE OF GRUNGSSON
abilities.declare: Pick up to 2 other friendly SKYFARER units within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: LIGHT ENDRINPACKS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 2D6" but must end that move in combat.

abilities.name: SPECIALIST GRUNDSTOK AMMUNITION
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase, Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit
abilities.declare: Pick Shieldbreaker ammunition or Thunderdrakk ammunition.
abilities.effect:
If all of the attacks made for that SHOOT ability target the same enemy unit, after that SHOOT ability has been resolved, roll a dice and add the number of damage points allocated to the target by that SHOOT ability. If the roll is higher than the target’s Control characteristic, apply the following effect to the target based on the ammunition type picked:
Shieldbreaker: Ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn.
Thunderdrakk: That target has a maximum control score of 1 until the start of your next turn.

abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Arkanaut Company unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: CUSTOMISED NULLSUIT
abilities.effect:
This unit can use UNBIND and BANISH abilities as if it had WIZARD (1).

abilities.name: DILIGENT RESEARCHER
abilities.effect: Each time your opponent spends any rage dice as part of the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability, after that ability has been resolved, if this unit is not in combat, it can move up to XD6", where X is the number of rage dice spent. It cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: SUMMON SOULSNARE SHACKLES
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulsnare Shackles endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Soulsnare Shackles endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulsnare Shackles endless spell has 3 parts that must each be set up within 3" of at least 1 other part.

abilities.name: SUMMON MALEVOLENT MAELSTROM
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Malevolent Maelstrom on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Malevolent Maelstrom wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON SUFFOCATING GRAVETIDE
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Suffocating Gravetide on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Suffocating Gravetide wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON PURPLE SUN OF SHYISH
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Purple Sun of Shyish on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Purple Sun of Shyish wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Hearthflares
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 5 to the control scores of friendly Khazalite Holds units while they are contesting the target.

abilities.name: Deep-earth Runic Weapon
abilities.declare: Pick 1 of this unit's non-Companion melee weapons to be the runic weapon. This unit can use this ability even if it is in reserve.
abilities.effect:
Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the runic weapon for the rest of the battle. Then, pick 1 of the following:
Strike a Rune: Roll a dice. On a 3+, also add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the runic weapon for the rest of the battle.
Repeatedly Strike a Rune: Roll a dice. On a 5+, also add 1 to the Attacks characteristic and Damage characteristic of the runic weapon for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Flamescale Rune Cloak
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit if it has not charged this turn.

abilities.name: SIMMERING RAGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: You must use this ability.
abilities.effect: Gain a number of rage dice equal to your fury level. At the end of the battle round, any unspent rage dice are lost.

abilities.name: RAISING THE HEAT
abilities.effect: If you are the attacker, set your fury level to 1. If you are the defender, set your fury level to 2.

abilities.name: ERUPTION OF FURY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with that friendly unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the melee weapons that the unit using this ability is armed with. Then, spend up to 3 rage dice.
Resolve a number of combat attacks against the target using the melee weapon you picked equal to the number of rage dice you spent.
Those attacks cannot score critical hits. Instead, for each unmodified hit roll of 6 for those attacks:
Inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the unit using this ability.
Your opponent must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for those attacks, allocate D3 mortal damage to this unit after the damage sequence has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
Designer’s Note: Rage dice do not add to the Attacks characteristic of the weapon you pick; if you spend 3 rage dice to use this ability, you only make 3 combat attacks.

abilities.name: FIGHT THROUGH THE PAIN
abilities.effect: Before allocating damage to a friendly unit, you can spend any number of rage dice. For each rage dice spent, reduce your fury level by 1, to a minimum of 0, then roll a dice. On a 3+, remove 1 damage point from that unit’s damage pool.

abilities.name: Bellicose Belligerents
abilities.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with any friendly Khazalite Holds units.

abilities.name: TRAVEL THE NIDUS PATHS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of a Nidus Path to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of the linked Nidus Path in the opposite corner of the battlefield, more than 9" from all enemy units.
When the underdog uses this ability, they can choose to set up the target wholly within 12" of any Nidus Path and more than 9" from all enemy units instead of the linked Nidus Path in the opposite corner of the battlefield.

abilities.name: ESCAPE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 6" of the escape point in enemy territory to use this ability, then pick an objective it is contesting to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target objective and the unit using this ability from the battlefield. That unit has escaped.

abilities.name: GRAB THE REALMSTONE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability, then pick an objective it is contesting, that you control and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target objective from the battlefield and set it up again within 3" of the unit using this ability and not on a terrain feature.

abilities.name: THE RITUAL
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of the Mother Cauldron to be the target. Then, roll a dice.
abilities.effect: On a 1, the Mother Cauldron is destroyed. On a 2+, the target is destroyed.

abilities.name: SECURE NEW GROUND
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for friendly units’ combat attacks while they contest an objective that you do not control.

abilities.name: RESERVE CONTINGENT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit in the second turn force or the third turn force that has not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit in reserve. It has now been deployed.

abilities.name: ARRIVAL OF RESERVES
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit in reserve.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit anywhere wholly within friendly territory more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: BACKBONE OF SUCCESS
abilities.effect: While a non-HERO unit is contesting an objective, HEROES contesting that objective have a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: SEISMIC SHIFT
abilities.effect: Remove 1 objective from the battlefield.

abilities.name: TOP OF THE FOOD CHAIN
abilities.declare: Pick 3 friendly units to bе the targets.
abilities.effect: Each target has the PREDATOR keyword for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: THE RITUAL
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Battle Round
abilities.effect:
Gain D6 ritual points if you control the Ritual Site.
Gain D3 ritual points for each Arcane Repository you control.
Lose D3 ritual points for each Arcane Repository that you do not control.

abilities.name: SLAIN ON THE PLACE OF POWER
abilities.effect: Each time an enemy HERO that is contesting an objective is slain by a combat attack made by a friendly HERO, add the Control characteristic of that slain HERO to the control score of that friendly HERO for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Rune of Might
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Khazalite Holds Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly Khazalite Holds units while they are within 3" of the caster.

abilities.name: Rune of Sanctuary
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Khazalite Holds Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while they are wholly within 12" of the caster, friendly Khazalite Holds units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them.

abilities.name: Rune of Warding
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Khazalite Holds Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while they are within 12" of the caster, attacks made by enemy units cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).

abilities.name: NAVIGATE THE TUNNELS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 6" of a terrain feature that has a hidden passage token to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of a different terrain feature that has a hidden passage token and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SHIFTING PASSAGES
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick 2 non-FACTION TERRAIN terrain features to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Remove all hidden passage tokens from the battlefield (if any). Then, give each target a hidden passage token.

abilities.name: TO THE SHIPS!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick the Heldenhain or a Sun Seekers objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield.

abilities.name: ARCANE CHARGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick a Place of Power you control to be the target.
abilities.effect: Draw a straight line from the centre of the primary objective to the target. If that line crosses any secondary objectives, the first secondary objective that the line crosses is now the primary objective and all other objectives are now secondary objectives.

abilities.name: NAUGHTY OR NICE?
abilities.effect:
If you are the naughty player, friendly units’ melee weapons have Crit (Auto-wound) while they are contesting Da Red Gobbo.
If you are the nice player, friendly units have WARD (6+) while they are contesting Da Red Gobbo

abilities.name: CLANK, CLANK, CLANK
abilities.effect:
Roll 3D6. If Da Red Gobbo is within a number of inches of the exit point equal to the roll, he escapes, the battle ends immediately and both players lose.
Otherwise, pick a point on the battlefield within a number of inches of Da Red Gobbo equal to the roll. That point must be as near as possible to the exit point. Remove Da Red Gobbo from the battlefield and set him up again as near as possible to that point and more than 1" from all terrain features. If you are the underdog, set him up again within 6" of that point and more than 1" from all terrain features instead.

abilities.name: MAGNIFICENT MONSTROSITY
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect. If any enemy units are contesting Da Red Gobbo, you can add or subtract 1 from the roll (to a minimum of 1).
1
…Da Green Button?: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each unit’s melee weapons (friendly and enemy) for the rest of the turn.
2
…Da Blue Button?: Each player can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll or 1 random characteristic roll for a weapon’s Damage characteristic this turn.
3
…Da Yellow Button?: Each player gains 1 command point.
4
…Da Orange Button?: Each unit (friendly and enemy) on the battlefield has a Move characteristic of 3D6" for the rest of the turn.
5
…Da Purple Button?: Units (friendly and enemy) are not visible to other units outside their combat range for the rest of the turn.
6
…Da Red Button?: You must immediately use the ‘Clank, Clank, Clank’ ability as if it were the end of your turn.
7+
…Da Whirly Button?: Pick an enemy unit within 18" of Da Red Gobbo. Remove that unit from the battlefield. Then your opponent picks a point on the battlefield. Set up that enemy unit within 1" of that point and more than 9" from all enemy units. Each model in that enemy unit that cannot be set up in this way is automatically slain.

abilities.name: Fury of Vulcatrix
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Fyreslayers Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Fyreslayers unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect:
Add 1 to hit rolls for the target's combat attacks, including those made with Companion weapons, until the start of your next turn.
In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons, including Companion weapons, until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Blazing Impetus
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Fyreslayers Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Fyreslayers unit that was not set up this turn and that is wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Each target can use the 'Normal Move' or 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase.

abilities.name: Ichor of the Ur-Salamander
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Fyreslayers Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Fyreslayers unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect:
If the chanting roll was 6+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn:
• If the target is a Magmadroth, each time its 'Volcanic Blood' ability would inflict 1 mortal damage on an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage instead.
• If the target is a non‑Magmadroth unit, each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets that unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the Fight ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: SUMMON ZHARRGRON FLAME-SPITTER
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Zharrgron Flame-spitter on the battlefield, pick a friendly FYRESLAYERS PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Zharrgron Flame-spitter wholly within 12" of the chanter and visible to them.

abilities.name: SUMMON RUNIC FYREWALL
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Runic Fyrewall on the battlefield, pick a friendly FYRESLAYERS PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Runic Fyrewall wholly within 12" of the chanter and visible to them.

abilities.name: SUMMON MOLTEN INFERNOTH
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Molten Infernoth on the battlefield, pick a friendly FYRESLAYERS PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Molten Infernoth wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON KRONDSPINE INCARNATE OF GHUR

abilities.effect: Set up a Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Lock Shields!
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly Khazalite Holds units while they are wholly within friendly territory or while every model in the unit is contesting an objective you control.

abilities.name: SUMMON BURNING HEAD
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly The Burning Head on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up The Burning Head wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON EMERALD LIFESWARM
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Emerald Lifeswarm on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an Emerald Lifeswarm wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON RAVENAK’S GNASHING JAWS
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Ravenak’s Gnashing Jaws endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Ravenak’s Gnashing Jaws endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: TREAD CAREFULLY
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of First Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within friendly territory to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target is no longer stable.

abilities.name: VIOLENT TREMOR
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick a pair of objectives to be the targets.
abilities.effect: The stable target objective is no longer stable. The other target objective is stable instead.

abilities.name: ALL THE RAGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick a pair of objectives to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle round, the target is the coveted pair of objectives instead of the other pair of objectives.
